description: Fork of exp115 (MHLut+smooth+na=1) with clean nap<->n_sparse trade: nap 8 -> 10 (table_dim 256 -> 1024, 4x larger), n_sparse 8 -> 2 (4x smaller per-table output). tph unchanged (qk/v 384, out 2048). Per-layer LUT weights identical (qk/v 6*384*1024*2=4.72M, out 1*2048*1024*2=4.19M). What changes: bigger tables expressing 4x more input-pair patterns each, but each emits only 2 scattered values instead of 8. Total scatter destinations 4x less (qk/v 4608 vs 18432, out 4096 vs 16384). Tests whether per-table multi-output diversity matters more than per-table input expressiveness.
